turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on he, she and it with -s?
turns.tutor:
Sure. Let me think out loud with one example.
I work on Mondays. Sara works on Mondays. Sara is she, not I, so work needs -s: works.
The rule in one line: after he, she or it, add -s to the verb.
Right: It rains a lot here. Wrong: It rain a lot here.

Now you try. Write only the verb in the gap:
Write the correct form: My sister ___ (play) tennis on Sundays. (answer with only the verb)
